reason: zod reaches the tree only through @tasknotes/model, whose every release pins zod 3.x, and no 3.x release is patched. The plugin imports only the model's date, recurrence, operations and mapping modules, none of which uses zod, so the released main.js contains no zod code and the memory-exhaustion path cannot run in the plugin.
removeWhen: @tasknotes/model depends on a zod release outside the advisory's affected range; the check then reports this entry as stale.
